CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 04 / 10

Scarcity, choices and opportunity cost

Sunk cost沉沒成本

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Recognize a sunk cost and exclude it from a forward-looking decision; compare the additional benefit and additional cost of proceeding.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

無法收回的過去支出不隨今天的選擇改變。繼續與否只比較未來相關成本及收益；若可出售資產，放棄的售價仍有關。

An unrecoverable past cost cannot change with today's decision. Compare the future benefit and future cost of continuing; include any recoverable resale value that would be sacrificed.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Already spent $5m; finishing costs $1m and yields $3m. Continue because 3−1 = +$2m. 已花 $5m 不影響現在完成的額外淨收益。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Past research cost $8m; completion costs $2m; new revenue $1.5m. What should the firm do? 應否完成？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
